Comment transformer mon but en programme: How do I turn my goal into a schedule to follow, mission by mission?
Le business plan a ses propres questions: The business plan has its own questions: your goal (buy something, have a certain amount, or unlock something with experience: rank, XP, reputation…), where you stand, how you make your money (your missions, or an amount per hour), what you need to buy first, and what matters to you. Nothing is silently pulled from the eight calculations: a “Reuse my numbers from My calculations” button copies them if you want. In return you get: your schedule in order (first, second, third… session after session, with the fastest route found using your missions), your next session, backup plans A, B, C if things don’t go as planned, and tracking that rebuilds the whole plan after each session.
Cinq questions : « Quel est ton but ? »,: Five questions: “What’s your goal?”, “Where do you stand?”, “How do you make your money?”, “Before your goal”, “What matters to you”. The answer tells you what you’re missing, the number of sessions and days, what you do first, then “Your next session” (the missions to do, what you earn, what you buy next). Below that, the document in “main points”: the schedule in order, the backup plans, “Where do you really stand?”, your starting point, the suggested order for the purchases to make first. Each point already shows the essentials in its title; tap it to open the details (“Expand all” opens them all).
Tout s’affiche en plus : chaque partie a: Everything else shows up too: each session with its missions, earnings, and purchases, “What order should I buy them in?” (let the calculator choose, your order, what pays off fastest, the cheapest, straight to your goal, dipping into the money set aside), “What if…?”, “What changes everything”, the curve of your money with your real results, the calendar, “My plan variants” (keep this plan before trying something else), the formula, and “All the numbers in the calculation”. On the curve, you can fix a real point in one click; in “What if the number moves by 20%?”, clicking −20% or +20% uses that number.
Un déblocage ne se fait qu’une fois et u: An unlock only happens once and a purchase you need first is only paid for once; the time it takes to get it counts. “Lowest point” shows when you have the least money. If a must-have number is missing, the answer says “Path to complete” and tells you what to enter. If no plan keeps your money set aside, the plan is blocked and explains what to do: choose “As fast as possible” (the plan then dips into the money set aside and says so at every step) or change what you keep set aside. With no session duration, the path waits for the most profitable mission instead of starting just any mission, and it tells you if it leaves a mission out to go faster. The ammo you simulate in Expert mode is added to the fees of each attempt. Planned, started, and done are separate: “started” counts for nothing, only “done” (or a session you actually logged) changes the calculation, and the same session is never counted twice.
Tous les critères de cet outil (22), ave: All this tool’s criteria (22), in the words of “What matters in this calculation”
<1>Mission ou rang à débloquer</1> <2>Co: <1>Mission or rank to unlock</1> <2>Condition</2>: A step to do once before you can access an activity.
Choisis ton but : une fiche du site ou u: Choose your goal: a page from the site or a custom purchase with its price (the price you imagine if it isn’t known), an amount to have, or something to unlock with points (say how many you need, how many you have, and what it costs afterward).
Écris ce que tu as, ce que tu gardes de: Enter what you have, what you keep set aside, the duration of a session, your days per week, and how many of you play (a mission that needs more players than your group is left out, and you’re told so). Then say how you make your money: your missions (reward, fees, duration, cooldown… “Or reuse a mission you already entered” copies them from My activities; “Reuse my numbers from My calculations” brings everything over: missions, group, expenses per session, running costs, dependencies) or an amount per hour.
Ajoute ce qu’il faut acheter avant ton b: Add what you need to buy before your goal (a page from the site or a custom purchase), what each purchase earns you afterward, and say where you stand on each one: “Planned”, “Started (not mine yet)”, or “Already mine”. A mission can require one of these purchases: the plan buys it at the right time and unlocks the mission. A one-time mission is marked the same way: planned, started, or already done.
Choisis ce qui compte pour toi (équilibr: Choose what matters to you (balance, fastest, safety, cheapest over the whole path), a deadline if you have one, then read your schedule. After each session, enter what you have, the time played, the missions done, and the purchases made: the whole plan recalculates, and the backup plans stay there if you earned less than expected.

Croire que la date est une promesse. C’e: Thinking the date is a promise. It’s a calculation with your numbers, assuming you always play the same way; if a number changes, the plan is redone. And a purchase is never paid for with the money it will earn itself.
Sources et statuts : ce qu’on sait vraim: Sources and statuses: what we really know
Il y a deux choses différentes : ce qu’o: There are two different things: what we know about an item, and what we know about a number. A boat can have an official name while its price, its speed, or whether you can buy it separately are still unknown.
Lire les informations sans leur faire di: Reading the info without reading too much into it
Une source officielle confirme la donnée: An official source confirms the stated info. Check which one: name, look, bonus, or exact number.
Un média ou une identification décrit un: A media item or an identification describes something. That doesn’t confirm whether it can be bought or owned, or what its stats are.
Une mesure documentée porte une source,: A documented measurement comes with a source, a date, and a context. It isn’t automatically a value published by Rockstar.
Un chiffre que tu écris pour faire le ca: A number you enter to run the calculation. It doesn’t become confirmed GTA VI data.
La valeur manque. Elle reste vide et n’e: The value is missing. It stays empty and is never replaced with zero.
Les bonus liés à l’Édition Ultimate ou a: Bonuses tied to the Ultimate Edition or the Vintage Vice City Pack spell out their conditions. A simulation of their separate cost stays personal. Collections without an item list stay empty in the calculator and in the progress checkboxes.

C’est l’argent que tu reçois à la fin d’: It’s the money you get at the end of a mission, before paying your fees. It’s not what you actually have left.
C’est ce qu’il te reste une fois tes fra: It’s what you have left once your fees are paid. Reward $100,000, fees $20,000: your earnings are $80,000.
ROI : ce que rapporte un achat en %: ROI: what a purchase earns you, in %
C’est ce qu’un achat t’a fait gagner, en: It’s what a purchase has earned you, as a percentage of its price: earned in the end ÷ price × 100. 0% means paid back; 100% means it earned twice its price.
C’est le moment où un achat t’a rapporté: It’s the point when a purchase has earned you as much as it cost. In “Is it worth it?”, the calculator tells you after how many hours of play you get there.
C’est ce que rapporte une somme dépensée: It’s what a sum you spend earns you over a given period. An amount per hour of play isn’t a return: you also need to say how long you use it.
C’est la part de ton argent que tu ne ve: It’s the part of your money you don’t want to spend. The calculator never touches it: for your purchases, it acts as if that money didn’t exist.
Pourquoi mon résultat change dans plusie: Why does my result change in several tools?
« J’ai déjà », l’argent de côté, tes ach: “I already have”, the money set aside, your purchases, and your activities are the same everywhere. Changing a purchase’s price also changes your budget, your buying order, and “Is it worth it?” Save a copy to compare two versions.
Pourquoi Simple et Expert donnent le mêm: Why do Simple and Expert give the same result?
Le mode change ce qu’on te montre, pas l: The mode changes what you’re shown, not the calculation. Expert lets you change extra settings; going back to Simple doesn’t erase them.
Pourquoi aucune activité ne rentre dans: Why does no activity fit in my play time?
Regarde sa durée avec la préparation, le: Check its duration with prep, the fees to pay first, the players needed, and the checked activities. An activity only pays once it’s finished.
Comment corriger une case vide ou un nom: How do I fix an empty field or a rejected number?
Écris un nombre, par exemple 25000 ou 25: Enter a number, for example 25000 or 25,000.50. Durations, prices, and “I already have” can’t be negative. The message under the field says what’s missing.
Pourquoi un prix officiel n’apparaît-il: Why isn’t an official price showing?
Le site ne possède peut-être aucune donn: The site may not have any verified economic data for this page yet. You can run a clearly named personal simulation, or wait for official info. The edition’s retail price in euros isn’t the item’s in-game price in dollars.
Quelle différence entre Mon business pla: What’s the difference between My business plan and My progress?
Mon business plan part d’un but (un acha: My business plan starts from a goal (a purchase or an amount) and your numbers, then gives you the order of the steps and the play time needed. My progress tracks items you check off on the site. Neither of them reads a save from your console.
Comment emporter mes données sur un autr: How do I take my data to another device?
Dans Progression, exporte ton suivi. Sur: On the Progress page, export your progress. On the other device, import that file, read the preview, then choose Merge or Replace for the sections in the file. Older compatible saves are migrated; unknown references are flagged.
Le site respecte le réglage de mouvement: The site follows your device’s reduced motion setting. Answers and steps are visible right away. Screenshots are still images, and the highlighted zones can be read without animation.
Que fait le champ « Que veux-tu calculer: What does the calculator’s “What do you want to calculate?” field do?
Il reconnaît des mots-clés et certains m: It recognizes keywords and some amounts to open a tool and prefill fields. Always check the values it picked up; it doesn’t look up official earnings and can’t guarantee it understands every sentence.
